create_namedranges_from_counts: create a NamedRanges instance from a dictionary mapping names to integer counts for array indexing
access_named_array_slices: access named slices of a numpy array by string key using NamedArray bracket notation
convert_lengths_to_ranges: convert a mapping of name-to-length integers into contiguous index ranges with lengths_to_ranges function
set_named_array_values: set values in a NamedArray for a named range using bracket assignment syntax
export_named_array_to_dict: export a NamedArray to a dictionary mapping each name to its corresponding numpy array slice
